remarks: Investor friendly opportunity - strong rental demand and low-maintenance ownership! Don't miss the chance to own this charming first-floor 1-bedroom, 1-bath home in a highly desirable location. This bright and inviting unit features brand-new wall-to-wall carpeting, a new refrigerator, and a stylish kitchen backsplash.  Enjoy year-round comfort with heat included, helping keep monthly expenses predictable. The versatile layout offers flexibility for a dedicated home office or additional living space. The bathroom includes a window for natural light and ventilation, while ample closet space provides excellent storage.  Additional conveniences include a lower-level common laundry room and one assigned outdoor parking space. Ideally located directly across from a bus stop and just minutes from Metro-North, offering an easy commute to Grand Central Terminal or New Haven/Yale.  Currently tenant-occupied with a tenant interested in renewing, making this an attractive opportunity for investors or buyers seeking a low-maintenance property in a convenient location.
